title: Chirality as evidence for God in The Case for God
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Chirality as evidence for God in The Case for God, about Unspecified at Unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I put this in a book uh years ago uh the case for God.

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who appears on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he wrote years ago in a book called The Case for God about chirality, the fact that many of life's molecules come in a left-handed or right-handed form, like a pair of gloves. He offers this as a sign that life was designed by God rather than arising by chance.
